rules.name: Applicable applicants/products
rules.statement: Collect independent records only for selected member/spouse product elections with positive requested amounts that participate under the effective configured category default and product/applicant/Association policy. The global default is Life/AD; explicit participation exceptions remain authoritative. Retained amount defaults and child coverage do not create adult beneficiary elections.

rules.name: Optional page opt-in
rules.statement: When Beneficiary mode is optional, the page first asks whether the user wants to add beneficiary information. No skips the beneficiary questions and permits continuation.

rules.name: Required beneficiary per applicable product
rules.statement: When beneficiary questions are active, each applicable product/applicant must have at least one Primary beneficiary before continuing. Contingent beneficiaries are optional and cannot satisfy the Primary requirement. An individual or a trust can be Primary.

rules.name: Add/edit/remove modal
rules.statement: Clicking 'Add Beneficiary' on a product card opens an AppModal. The modal shows: designation tabs (Primary / Contingent) with a remaining-slot counter; beneficiary type selector (Individual or Trust); and type-specific fields. Individual fields: First Name, Last Name, Relationship, % Share with 25/50/75/100% quick-fill buttons and a live 'X% unassigned remaining' display. Trust fields: Name of Trust and Date of Trust. Clicking Edit pre-populates the modal with the existing record. The 'Add Beneficiary' button is replaced by an info alert when both designations are fully maxed.

rules.name: Primary/contingent designation
rules.statement: Each beneficiary is designated as Primary or Contingent, selected via tabs in the add/edit modal.

rules.name: Individual vs. trust
rules.statement: A beneficiary can be an Individual or Trust. Within the same Primary/Contingent designation, trust and individual beneficiary types cannot be mixed.

rules.name: Maximum beneficiaries
rules.statement: Use the compiled individual/trust surface limits independently for each product/applicant and designation; reaching capacity blocks additional entries. A trust is the sole record for its designation.

rules.name: Individual allocation
rules.statement: Individual beneficiary shares use canonical whole percentages greater than 0 and cannot exceed the unassigned percentage remaining for that designation. Reject fractional, scientific-notation and noncanonical saved share values; each populated individual designation must total exactly 100% on Next.

rules.name: Allocation reaches 100%
rules.statement: Once the assigned individual share reaches 100% for a designation, no more individual beneficiaries can be added for that designation.

rules.name: Trust exclusivity
rules.statement: Only one Trust may be added per Primary/Contingent designation; if a Trust exists, additional individuals or trusts are blocked for that designation.

rules.name: Apply to other coverages
rules.statement: After adding a beneficiary, offer copying to other eligible member or spouse product/applicant targets when compatible targets exist. Preselect compatible targets. Copies receive independent IDs and preserve the source record. Editing does not automatically offer copying; existing records can be copied explicitly. Revalidate all targets atomically against current participation and allocation rules before writing. Do not offer the action when no eligible compatible target remains.

rules.name: Inherit shared Site product/category presentation
rules.statement: Use the shared effective Site category/product ordering, configured names and featured/first-category entry priorities for applicable selected products. Determine the QD indicator from the selected applicant/product underwriting outcome. Definition notes remain independent of participation and allocation validation.

rules.name: Complete each populated individual designation before continuing
rules.statement: On Next, individual beneficiary shares must total exactly 100% independently for each populated primary or contingent designation, per applicable product/applicant. At least one Primary beneficiary is required; Contingent beneficiaries are optional. Empty Contingent designations and trusts have no share-total input requirement. Add/edit/copy may save valid partial allocations while records are assembled; positive shares, available capacity, type exclusivity and the 100% upper bound still apply. Drafts may temporarily have only Contingent records, but Next cannot continue until a Primary is added for each applicable product/applicant.
rules.source: User decision November 13, 2026; src/domain/beneficiaryValidation.ts; src/pages/Beneficiary.tsx; User clarification November 13, 2026

rules.name: Validate beneficiary participation and note assignments
rules.statement: Resolve beneficiary participation from current product/applicant elections and the effective Association context. Intersect assigned availability with URL scope and explicit elections while retaining inactive drafts. Reject note or participation policies outside the assigned product/applicant/Association scope. Membership attestation does not identify an Association. The same assigned statement is used wherever its content key applies.
